subject.title: Migration-import preview/confirm/result screens print the raw MigrationPlan without the redaction pass used by report.json / JSON output

question: Should maintainers route this migration text-output redaction bug through a security-owned fix/review path before any public repair PR?
rationale: The issue affects credential-shaped terminal output and is already labeled as needing security review with no new automated fix PR recommended, so automation should not independently open the patch.

options.title: Security-owned narrow fix
options.body: A maintainer reviews and lands a focused redaction-boundary change with formatter regression tests for `message` and `reason`.

options.title: Authorize automated repair
options.body: Maintainers may remove the no-new-fix-pr constraint or explicitly authorize ClawSweeper to attempt the same narrow fix.

options.title: Broaden to migration-output audit
options.body: Maintainers may expand the work into a wider audit of all migration text surfaces before landing the fix.

recommendation.title: Security-owned narrow fix
recommendation.body: A maintainer reviews and lands a focused redaction-boundary change with formatter regression tests for `message` and `reason`.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checkout blame and recent migration-adjacent history point to this owner as the most likely reviewer for a security-sensitive migration output boundary decision.
